E0973

A `target` (or cross-compile platform) names a platform Jet doesn't know.

What

A `target` (or cross-compile platform) names a platform Jet doesn't know.

Why

D-JPK-PLATFORM1 makes `target` a typed platform value, not quoted text — it must be `linux.x64` or `linux.arm64`, so it type-checks and LSP-completes.

Fix

Write `target: linux.x64` or `target: linux.arm64`.
